baseline_construction_method.value: Statistical energy characterisation: for each furnace the electricity consumption is regressed against a single energy driver (tapped molten mass) using two years of monthly data; because the least-squares intercept was not statistically significant a regression through the origin was used. A complementary deterministic (thermodynamic) approach and tabular-CUSUM reference-period selection support the model.
